review_candidates.title: Civil Structural Engineer

Join a collaborative engineering team where you'll contribute to the design of commercial, industrial, institutional, and public infrastructure projects. You'll work alongside experienced professionals who are committed to mentorship, innovation, and delivering high-quality structural solutions. Position Overview We are seeking a Structural Design Engineer to join our growing team. This role offers the opportunity to participate in every phase of structural engineering projects, from preliminary design through construction support. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and producing practical, efficient designs that meet client objectives. Key Responsibilities Design structural systems for commercial, industrial, municipal, and institutional projects. Prepare structural calculations, engineering reports, specifications, and construction documents. Develop designs utilizing steel, reinforced concrete, wood, and masonry construction. Perform structural analysis using industry-standard engineering software. Coordinate with architects, civil engineers, contractors, and project managers throughout the design process. Review shop drawings, respond to contractor requests for information (RFIs), and provide construction-phase support. Conduct occasional field visits to verify existing conditions and observe construction progress. Ensure designs comply with applicable building codes, industry standards, and client requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering with a Structural emphasis or Structural Engineering. Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred or ability to obtain licensure. 4+ years of structural engineering experience preferred. Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, and structural analysis software such as RAM Structural System, RISA, STAAD.Pro, ETABS, or similar programs. Strong understanding of IBC, ASCE 7, ACI, AISC, NDS, and other applicable design standards. Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. What We Offer We believe successful engineers are developed through mentorship, collaboration, and meaningful project experience. You'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects while continuing to build your technical expertise and leadership skills in a supportive environment. Benefits We offer a competitive compensation package that includes: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with company matching Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave Performance-based bonus opportunities Annual compensation reviews Professional development and continuing education assistance Flexible work schedule options Life and disability insurance Team-oriented culture with opportunities for career advancement Why Join Our Team? Our engineers work on projects that strengthen communities and create lasting value. We encourage innovation, support professional growth, and foster an environment where collaboration and technical excellence drive success. If you're looking for a place to continue building your structural engineering career while working on impactful projects, we'd love to hear from you. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, age, color, sex (including pregnancy), religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations. GPAC (Growing People and Companies) is an award-winning search firm specializing in placing quality professionals within multiple industries across the United States since 1990. We are extremely competitive, client-focused and realize that our value is in our ability to deliver the right solutions at the right time.

review_candidates.title: Business Development Lead - Power Consulting (UK & Europe)
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity We are seeking a commercially driven Business Development Lead to grow the Power Consulting business, with a focus on Europe & UK . This role is central to expanding our consulting footprint with utilities, transmission operators, developers, industrial customers, and fast‑growing segments such as data centres and e‑mobility. You will work closely with Hitachi Energy’s regional Sales and Business Unit teams to position Power Consulting as a high‑value, trusted partner in the European energy transition. This is a high‑impact, autonomous role for someone who combines strong commercial skills with deep energy market insight How You'll Make An Impact Drive profitable growth of the Power Consulting business across the UK and support expansion throughout Europe. Build and strengthen strategic relationships with utilities, transmission operators, developers, industrial customers, data centres, and e-mobility stakeholders. Identify, develop, and convert consulting opportunities aligned with energy transition priorities, including grid modernization, renewables integration, HVDC, storage, and digital solutions. Own the full sales lifecycle from opportunity identification and pursuit strategy through proposal development, negotiation, and contract award. Collaborate with regional Sales teams, Business Units, and Hitachi Group companies to maximize market opportunities and customer value. Monitor market, regulatory, and competitive developments to shape business strategy and position Power Consulting as a trusted advisor. Represent Hitachi Energy at industry events, enhancing market visibility and strengthening customer engagement. Champion Hitachi Energy's values of safety, integrity, and accountability in all business activities.. Your Background Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Business, or related field (Master’s or PhD advantageous). 5+ years’ experience in sales, business development, or consulting within the power or energy sector. Strong experience in the UK energy market with an established professional network. Good understanding of power systems, renewables integration, grid modernisation, HVDC, storage, and digital solutions. Experience across European energy markets is an advantage. Proven track record in consultative selling and closing complex engagements. Comfortable working autonomously in a fast‑evolving environment. Valid work authorisation for the UK and willingness to travel (up to 40%). More About Us Hitachi Energy's Power Consulting unit helps utilities, ISOs, developers, and large energy users solve complex grid and power-delivery challenges by combining deep technical credibility with pragmatic execution. Our consultants bring together world-class expertise in power system studies, market analysis, feasibility assessments, and digital solutions to support the global energy transition. With a growing global footprint and a commitment to sustainability, we offer the scale of a global organisation with the agility of a specialist consulting practice. Publication date : 2026-10-07

review_candidates.title: Associate, Emerging Talent - Talent Acquisition Team
review_candidates.description: The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems. CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally. At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work http//www.clintonhealthaccess.org CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture. Global Talent Acquisition (TA) Team Overview The Global Talent Acquisition (TA) team partners with hiring managers, program leadership, and country teams to identify, engage, and hire the people who help CHAI achieve its mission. The team supports full-cycle recruitment and sourcing across programs and country offices, using direct outreach, referrals, and internal candidates alongside job postings. Members of the team advise hiring managers on the talent market and the right approach for each search, and build inclusive, equitable practices into every step of the process. At CHAI, we work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. Our teams are respectful, collaborative, and humble, and we hold ourselves to a high standard. Position Overview CHAI's future talent pipeline depends on building strong, sustained relationships with the right universities globally, and this role is central to making that happen. Working closely with programme leads and staff across the organization, the Emerging Talent Senior Associate manages CHAI's university partnerships and intern programme, ensuring CHAI is known and well regarded at the institutions that matter most. The role is hands-on and outward-facing, involving attendance at careers events, coordination with university careers services and student societies, and working with CHAI alumni from target institutions to bring them back as advocates and speakers. It also involves supporting the end-to-end management of CHAI's intern cohorts. Build and maintain active relationships with target universities globally, including their careers services, relevant faculty and student societies, ensuring CHAI has a consistent and visible presence at the institutions that matter most. Coordinate CHAI's attendance at university careers events and fairs, organising logistics, preparing materials and representing CHAI directly to students in a way that is engaging and grounded in the CHAI mission. Work with CHAI programme leads and staff who are alumni of target universities, activating them as advocates and speakers and coordinating their involvement in campus activities. Support the end-to-end coordination of CHAI's intern programme, managing the application process, communications, and logistics for each cohort and ensuring every intern has a well-organised, well-supported experience. Maintain a clear pipeline of emerging talent from target institutions, tracking engagement, applications, and outcomes in iCIMS (our ATS) with strong data integrity. Work with the wider TA team to develop and refine CHAI's approach to university partnerships, including which institutions to prioritise and what engagement at each looks like in practice. Liaise with the Brand & Attraction Specialist to ensure CHAI's presence at target universities is consistent with the broader employer brand and that materials are up-to-date and compelling. Produce straightforward reporting on university engagement and intern programme activity for the TA team. Experience in a campus recruiting, university partnerships or early careers role, or a role with significant involvement in events coordination and external relationship management. Comfortable representing an organisation directly to student audiences, with the confidence and interpersonal skills to make CHAI's story land with people who are early in their careers. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with experience coordinating programmes or events across multiple stakeholders and locations. Comfortable working with data and tracking tools, able to maintain accurate records and produce clear reporting on engagement activity. An understanding of what good early careers and intern programme management looks like, from application through to the end of a placement. A working knowledge of global health or international development sufficient to speak credibly about CHAI's mission to students and university partners. Fluency in both English and French. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Skills And Traits Hard Skills University and external relationship management, building consistent and productive partnerships with careers services, faculty, and student organisations over time. Events coordination, managing logistics for careers fairs, campus visits and speaking engagements across multiple institutions and geographies. Intern programme coordination, managing cohort communications, schedules, and logistics from application through to completion. ATS management and data integrity, maintaining accurate records of university engagement, applications, and pipeline activity in iCIMS. Content and materials support, working with the Brand & Attraction Specialist to ensure all university-facing materials are current, compelling and on-brand. Soft Skills Personable and confident in external settings, able to represent CHAI warmly and credibly to students, careers professionals and university partners. Highly organised and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, keeping university engagement, intern coordination and reporting all moving at the same time. Self-motivated and proactive, able to identify what needs to happen next without being directed at every step. A genuine interest in early careers and in connecting talented people to meaningful work in global health. A collaborative working style, working closely with programme leads, CHAI alumni and the wider TA team to make the partnerships work in practice. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in or recruiting for international NGOs, global health or international development organisations, with an understanding of the mission-driven candidate landscape. Experience working across multiple geographies and with universities in different regions, with an understanding of how student and institutional engagement varies by market.
